Sam W: Quick checkFriday evening watch party in the kitchen at 7? I can grab chips but need help on a fantasy flex pick 914
Maya P: Ill take guac. Ill bring small bowls if someone else brings chips. :avocado:
Raj S: Flex advice Henry for safe points, AJ Brown for upside. Whos your matchup?
Sam W: Im up against Elena C shes been on a heater lately. Thinking AJ but nervous about his target share.
Elena C: Bench-locking you mentally, @Sam W. Also Ill bring paper plates.
Devon: Team Henry here. Bringing those spicy kettle chips that vanish in 10 minutes. Warning: addictive.
Olivia: Chip poll time React 1"). for tortilla, 2"). for kettle, 3"). for multigrain. Also who wants a tiny $2 office pool for the game? Winner gets last week's pizza slice.
Ben T: 2"). from me. Yes on the pool. Small stakes, big pride.
Sam W: Ok final prep. Ill post my lineup for quick thumbs up.
Maya P: FYI, Julio is questionable per the app. Might affect AJs snaps.
Raj S: If Julio tests, AJ might eat into targets. Id still start AJ for the boom but have Henry ready.
Sam W: ```
Lineup:
QB: T. Bradley
RB1: Derrick Henry
RB2: Chark
WR1: AJ Brown
WR2: K. Allen
```

Olivia: I started a tiny signup sheet for chips: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-chips please add initials. Also added a mini bracket tab for $2 buy-in.
Elena C: I signed up for napkins and dip containers. @Snackbot can you confirm plates/napkins inventory for Friday?
Snackbot: Inventory check: plates 30, napkins 50. Ordering 20 extra forks based on past usage. :robot_face:
Devon: Bringing a small bluetooth speaker. Add tracks to the "Friday Bops" doc if you want tunes.
Ben T: Reminder: vote on chip poll and throw your $2 in the jar by 6:45pm.
Sam W: Decision: starting Henry to be safe, will swap to AJ if Julio is out or we need a boom. See everyone Friday! :football:
